name: OSPF adjacency change WITH a coincident link-down: a link fault dragging the IGP — prefer local-link-fault, not OSPF flap
comment: C5 discriminator: an IGP flap with a concurrent link_state_change is a symptom of the link fault. The ospf-adjacency-flap discriminator fires (link_state_change present) and defers to sig.ent.access.local-link-fault, which fully covers (link + interface anomaly on the same port) and wins.
